summary: "Next Gen" is named as the host of "Art After Dark," a monthly First-Friday late-night social/art mixer at the YMI Cultural Center in Asheville, described as celebrating Black art and Black social life. Only two listings exist (June and July 2026), both free and ticketed generically through Eventbrite under organizer "YMI Cultural Center" rather than a "Next Gen" organizer account, and no independent website, Facebook group, Meetup, or Instagram presence for a group called "Next Gen" could be found tied to YMI.

evidence.note: June listing: 'Join us for our new First Friday initiative that celebrates Black Art and Black Social Life' — framed as a new recurring series, not an established club, with no membership/dues/sign-up language.
July listing: 'Hosted by Next Gen, this exciting evening brings together all things community' — names Next Gen as host but gives no bio, links, or description of who Next Gen's members are.

Both events list the organizer as 'YMI Cultural Center,' not 'Next Gen,' and tags include 'Next Gen Creatives,' 'Community Mixer,' 'Social Mixer,' and 'LGBTQ+' — consistent with either a young-adults affinity group or simply a branded nightlife program name.
YMI Cultural Center's own site lists its programs (Goombay, Ujima Health & Wellness, tours, gallery, event rentals) with no mention of 'Next Gen' or 'Art After Dark' anywhere.
Rendered Eventbrite page has no organizer bio, social links, or membership info beyond the bare event details; no independent Facebook group, Meetup, or Instagram for 'Next Gen' turned up.
